topics.description: The Minnesota AG's office is under scrutiny for its handling of a large-scale fraud scheme. GOP Senate hopeful Michele Tafoya has accused AG Ellison and Governor Walz of ignoring the issue.
topics.reason: New developments in a large-scale fraud scheme in Minnesota

topics.description: The FBI is conducting several investigations into various fraud schemes and cases across the US. This includes a probe into a $340 million fraud scheme uncovered by the National Fraud Enforcement Division.
topics.reason: Ongoing FBI investigations into fraud schemes
